SURROUNDED_POWER.description: positioning state; attack damage to owner is multiplied by x1.5 when the attacker carries the matching BACK_ATTACK_LEFT_POWER / BACK_ATTACK_RIGHT_POWER marker for the owner's facing. Markers themselves are inert Single Buffs. Facing rule (decomp): the owner's facing flips whenever the player plays a card or potion targeting a creature whose BACK_ATTACK marker matches the opposite direction — targeting a claw turns the owner toward it, exposing the other claw as the ×1.5 flanker. On flank-creature death, facing re-targets to the remaining marker-bearer if all survivors share one marker side. LIVE run-58 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-205108-aa378115.log): facing flips on EVERY card/potion play targeting a creature — targeting Crusher dropped THRASH 18→12, the next Bash on Rocket flipped it back to 18 the same turn. Plan one flank side per turn; mixed-target turns pay the ×1.5 tax repeatedly.
SURROUNDED_POWER.live_notes: LIVE run-56: player-side debuff from KaiserCrab fight. Applied by Rocket slot — indicates dual-body surround state.
